text:
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER generated £4.4k revenue TW, the highest performing product, with 1,686 units sold across 57 orders.
- PARTY BUNTING achieved £3.2k revenue TW, placing it as the second strongest revenue driver for the week.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER delivered £2.4k revenue TW with 38 orders, demonstrating consistent customer demand.
- PACK OF 72 RETRO SPOT CAKE CASES led unit sales with 1,859 units sold TW, outperforming all other products by volume.
- WALL MIRROR RECT DIAMANTE PINK showed exceptional growth with revenue increasing 3,923.3% WoW, indicating a significant surge in demand.
- DIAMANTE HEART SHAPED WALL MIRROR experienced strong momentum with revenue up 1,596.6% WoW compared to LW.
- Total revenue reached £41.6k TW with 19,061 units sold across 769 orders.
- Overall portfolio revenue grew 38.5% WoW, reflecting broad-based strength across the product range.
